_about: Named inputs for each pinned graph in this folder. tools/comfy_compile.ts writes slot values into <file> by node id + input name. 'default' mirrors the pinned graph (the graph wins; drift prints a warning). 'invert': a boolean written negated. 'also': more inputs that get the same value. Pinned 2026-11-02 from completed Comfy Cloud jobs; see README.md.

trim_duration.desc: Seconds of clip to render; 0 = the whole clip. The pinned 5 caps renders at 5 s: fine for the 73-frame test chunks, too short for 8 s scenes. Use 0 with a clip pre-cut to 8n+1 frames.

prompt.default: A young Black woman with deep brown skin and copper-red hair pulled back, small white earbuds, faces the camera and lip-syncs to a song, nodding her head and sweeping one hand toward the lens. The whole scene is a bold cel-shaded anime music video: thick black ink outlines, flat hyper-saturated colors, her rich dark-brown skin glowing with hot magenta and electric cyan neon rim light, a glowing synthwave city at night behind her with rain streaks and drifting light particles. Her striped shirt becomes a glossy holographic jacket. Hard comic-book shadows, high contrast, vivid and energetic. A pulsing synth bass beat plays.

prompt.default: Keep the same young Black woman: her exact face, rich deep brown skin with warm undertones and a luminous dewy sheen, copper-red hair pulled back, small white earbuds, her exact pose, hand position and camera framing. Change only her wardrobe and the set. She now wears a burnt-orange silk slip dress with thin straps and small gold hoop earrings. The background becomes an intimate late-1990s R&B music video stage: warm amber fairy-light bokeh, soft haze, a candlelit glow, Tuscan brown velvet curtains. Lighting: a large soft warm key light from camera left, a gold bounce under her face and an amber rim light on her hair and shoulders.
